column1: # The owner's picture set (checks/6-pictures.sh): each screen's name in English for index.html and README.md.
# SOURCE<TAB>KEY<TAB>NAME. KEY is the picture's name without its language: the walk's screen (a further stretch
# "<screen>--N" takes its screen's name with "(part N)"), the session's NNN-name (a series "NNN-name-K" takes
# "NNN-name"'s with "(part K)"), the tests' TEST-name. A key not listed here is shown as it is.
